title: Chief Executive Order 11 Aga Khan University Amendment Order 2002

sections.shortTitle: Chief Executive Order 11 Aga Khan University Amendment Order 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S ORDER 11 OF 2002
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S ORDER 11 OF
2002
AGA KHAN UNIVERSITY
(AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2002
An Order to amend the Aga Khan
University Order. 1983
No.2‑5/2002‑Min. Dated
Islamabad the 2nd April, 2002.
Whereas it is expedient to amend
the Aga Khan University Order, 1983 (President's Order No.3 of 1983) for' the
purposes hereinafter appearing
Now, therefore, in pursuance of
the Proclamation of Emergency of the Fourteenth day of October, 1999, and the
Provisional Constitution Order No. l of 1999, and in exercise of all other
powers enabling him in that behalf, the Chief Executive of the Islamic Republic
of Pakistan is pleased to make and promulgate the following Order:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑(1) This Order may be called the Aga Khan University
(Amendment) Order, 2002 .
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of Article 2, President's Order No.3 of 1983

An Order to amend the Aga Khan
University Order. 1983
No.2‑5/2002‑Min. Dated
Islamabad the 2nd April, 2002.
Whereas it is expedient to amend
the Aga Khan University Order, 1983 (President's Order No.3 of 1983) for' the
purposes hereinafter appearing
Now, therefore, in pursuance of
the Proclamation of Emergency of the Fourteenth day of October, 1999, and the
Provisional Constitution Order No. l of 1999, and in exercise of all other
powers enabling him in that behalf, the Chief Executive of the Islamic Republic
of Pakistan is pleased to make and promulgate the following Order:‑‑
2. Amendment of Article 2,
President's Order No.3 of 1983.‑‑In the Aga Khan University
Order, 1983 (President's Order No.3 of 1983), hereinafter referred to as they
said Order, in Article 2,‑‑
(i) clause (a) shall be
renumbered) as clause (aa) and before clause (aa) renumbered as aforesaid, the
following new clause shall be inserted, namely:‑‑
"(a) 'Aga Khan Development
Network' means the network of international development agencies and
organizations, known as the Aga Khan Development Network, established by the
Ismaili Imamat and comprising the Aga Khan Foundation, the Aga Khan Education
Services, the Aga Khan Health Services, the Aga Khan Planning and Building
Services, the Aga Khan University, the Aga Khan Trust for Culture, and the Aga
Khan Fund for Economic Development."
(ii) after clause (b), the
following new clause shall be inserted, namely:‑
(bb) 'Chief Executive Officer'
means the Chief Executive Officer of the University appointed under Article 10
or with such other designation as may be determined by the Board and approved
by the Chancellor,"; and
(iii) clause (d) shall be
omitted.

Amendment of Article 4, President's ,Order No.3 of 1983

CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S ORDER 11 OF
2002
AGA KHAN UNIVERSITY
(AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2002
An Order to amend the Aga Khan
University Order. 1983
No.2‑5/2002‑Min. Dated
Islamabad the 2nd April, 2002.
Whereas it is expedient to amend
the Aga Khan University Order, 1983 (President's Order No.3 of 1983) for' the
purposes hereinafter appearing
Now, therefore, in pursuance of
the Proclamation of Emergency of the Fourteenth day of October, 1999, and the
Provisional Constitution Order No. l of 1999, and in exercise of all other
powers enabling him in that behalf, the Chief Executive of the Islamic Republic
of Pakistan is pleased to make and promulgate the following Order:‑‑
4. Amendment of Article 4,
President's ,Order No.3 of 1983.‑In the aforesaid Order, in Article
4,‑‑
(i) in clause (1), after the word
"learning" the words "in Pakistan and abroad" shall be
inserted;
(ii) in clause (2),‑‑
(a) for paragraph (e) the
following shall be substituted, namely:‑‑
"(e) pursue research, to
hold conferences, seminars and workshops and to publish and disseminate through
print, electronic and other means its research and academic work including the
establishment of websites on the internet;" and
(b) for paragraph (g) the
following shall be substituted, namely:‑
(g) affiliate itself or associate
with other universities, and institutions, and establish institutes, faculties,
centres, programmes, facilities and such other academic units in Pakistan or
abroad for better discharge of its functions and responsibilities;"
(iii) for clause (3) the
following shall be substituted, namely:‑‑
"(3) The principal teaching
facilities of the health science faculties of the University shall consist of
the Aga Khan University Hospital at Karachi, but the University shall have the
right to use the other institutions and programmes including those of the Aga
Khan Development Network in Pakistan and abroad and the facilities of any other
institution on terms to be settled by it with the Aga Khan Development Network
or such other institution;"; and
(iv) after clause (6), the
following new clause shall be added, namely:‑
"(7) The University shall
have an international address at Headquarters of the Aga Khan Development
Network in Geneva, Switzerland. "

University Order. 1983
No.2‑5/2002‑Min. Dated
Islamabad the 2nd April, 2002.
Whereas it is expedient to amend
the Aga Khan University Order, 1983 (President's Order No.3 of 1983) for' the
purposes hereinafter appearing
Now, therefore, in pursuance of
the Proclamation of Emergency of the Fourteenth day of October, 1999, and the
Provisional Constitution Order No. l of 1999, and in exercise of all other
powers enabling him in that behalf, the Chief Executive of the Islamic Republic
of Pakistan is pleased to make and promulgate the following Order:‑‑
5. Amendment of Article 10,
President's Order No.3 of 1983.‑‑In the said Order, in Article
10, after‑clause (2), the following new clauses shall be added, namely:‑‑
"(3) The Chief Executive
Officer may be designated as President of the University or such other
designation as may be determined by the Board and Approved by the Chancellor.
(4) Subject to the approval of
the Board and the Chancellor, the Chief Executive Officer may delegate such of
his powers and functions under this Order to such person as he may determine,
including but not limited to the academic and administrative affairs of the University.
Every such person shall report, and be responsible, to the Chief Executive
Officer, who shall be responsible to the Board.".

(i) for paragraph (b) the
following shall be substituted namely:‑‑
"(b) four nominees of the
Aga Khan Development Network to be nominated by the Aga Khan Foundation or
other agencies of the Aga Khan Development Network,";
(ii) in paragraph (g), the word
"and", occurring at the end, shall be omitted;
(iii) in paragraph (h), for the
full stop, at the end, the semi‑color shall be substituted; and
(iv) after paragraph (h), amended
as aforesaid, the following new paragraphs shall be added, namely:‑‑
"(i) not more than eight
persons of international renown; prominent because of their experience and
attainments, recommended by the Board and approved by the Chancellor
(j) not more than two members may
in the best interests of the University, be coopted by the Chancellor whenever
he considers it necessary. ".
(2) in clause (5), in paragraph
(g), before the word "deans" the word and comma "provost,"
shall be inserted.
